title: Technical Architect (AI/ML)
jobDescription: We are seeking a highly skilled AI/ML Engineer to join our technology team. In this role, you will build and deploy end-to-end machine learning pipelines, optimize existing algorithmic models, and integrate intelligent features into our core applications. Key Responsibilities: Model Development & Optimization: Design, train, and fine-tune machine learning and deep learning models. Implement cutting-edge AI techniques in natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, or generative AI. Conduct statistical analysis and A/B testing to evaluate and optimize model performance. Data & Pipeline Engineering Build and maintain scalable data pipelines to clean, preprocess, and ingest unstructured data. Collaborate with data teams to engineer high-utility features for model training. Ensure data quality, security, and compliance across all training datasets. Deployment & MLOps Deploy validated ML models into cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Maintain and monitor production models for latency, scalability, and data drift.Containerize applications using tools like Docker and Kubernetes for seamless delivery. Collaboration & Research Translate abstract business requirements into practical technical architectures. Keep up to date with the latest advancements in AI frameworks and LLM architectures.Document workflows, model schemas, and system architectures for internal knowledge sharing.

title: Assistant Operation Delivery Manager
jobDescription: We are seeking a highly motivated Assistant Operation Delivery Manager with 24-48 months of experience in cross-functional collaboration, strategic and operational delivery, and performance management. The ideal candidate will excel in operational management and service delivery governance, ensuring adherence to service level agreements (SLAs). You will be responsible for process improvement initiatives, monitoring and reporting on key performance indicators (KPIs), and providing insightful analytics. Your role will involve collaborating with various teams to enhance service delivery and operational efficiency, driving continuous improvement across the organization. Requirements: - Proven experience in cross-functional collaboration and strategic operational delivery. - Strong background in performance management and operational management. - Expertise in service delivery governance and SLA management. - Demonstrated ability in process improvement and monitoring/reporting on KPIs. - Proficient in reporting and analytics to drive decision-making. - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with diverse teams.

title: SEO
jobDescription: - Proven experience in SEO with 24-48 months of hands-on experience. - Proficient in Google Analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog. - Strong understanding of SEO, GEO, and AEO strategies and best practices. - Ability to conduct comprehensive site audits and implement technical SEO improvements. - Familiarity with keyword research, on-page optimization, and link-building techniques. - Excellent analytical skills to interpret data and drive actionable insights for SEO performance.
